headline: Google Images gets Pinterest-like redesign for discovery
summary: Google Images now has a browsable gallery and AI image generation
details: Google Images is taking on Pinterest with its latest redesign, turning the site into a browsable, dynamic gallery of images from across the web. The redesign includes a 'For You' gallery of images tailored to users' interests and browsing history.

Users can save ideas to their 'collections,' which appear as tabs above the main gallery of photos. Collections can be created for topics like vacation outfit ideas, travel inspiration, and home decor.
The redesign is rolling out over the coming weeks on desktop in the U.S. in English, and users need to be signed into a Google Account to try it out.
Google is also adding AI image generation directly into Search, using its Nano Banana model to transform text prompts into custom visuals.
The image generation feature can help users reimagine spaces and visualize ideas, such as seeing what a room might look like painted red or what a dorm room with a coastal theme could look like.
caption:
Google Images just got a major Pinterest-style overhaul. What will you discover?

Google Images is taking on Pinterest with its latest redesign, turning the site into a browsable, dynamic gallery of images from across the web. The redesign includes a 'For You' gallery of images tailored to users' interests and browsing history.

Users can save ideas to their 'collections,' which appear as tabs above the main gallery of photos. Collections can be created for topics like vacation outfit ideas, travel inspiration, and home decor.

The redesign is rolling out over the coming weeks on desktop in the U.S. in English, and users need to be signed into a Google Account to try it out.

Google is also adding AI image generation directly into Search, using its Nano Banana model to transform text prompts into custom visuals.

The image generation feature can help users reimagine spaces and visualize ideas, such as seeing what a room might look like painted red or what a dorm room with a coastal theme could look like.

headline_marked: Google Images homepage now recommends photos [[before you search]]
headline: Google Images homepage now recommends photos before you search
summary: New 'browseable' homepage features a dynamic image gallery
details: Google is revamping its Images homepage with a new 'browseable' feature, showcasing a dynamic, immersive gallery of images from across the web, updated in real-time and tailored to your interests.
The new homepage will display a grid of images that Google thinks you might like before you even start searching, similar to platforms like Pinterest and Imgur.
You'll also be able to save images in collections that you can reference later, and those collections will show up as tabs above the feed.
The update is rolling out over the coming weeks for signed-in desktop users in the US in English.
Additionally, Google Search will soon be able to generate images in AI Overviews using its Nano Banana 2 Lite AI model.
caption:
Google Images homepage now shows recommended photos before search

Google is revamping its Images homepage with a new 'browseable' feature, showcasing a dynamic, immersive gallery of images from across the web, updated in real-time and tailored to your interests.

The new homepage will display a grid of images that Google thinks you might like before you even start searching, similar to platforms like Pinterest and Imgur.

You'll also be able to save images in collections that you can reference later, and those collections will show up as tabs above the feed.

The update is rolling out over the coming weeks for signed-in desktop users in the US in English.

Additionally, Google Search will soon be able to generate images in AI Overviews using its Nano Banana 2 Lite AI model.
